name: Cataclysm Era
description:
About This Game

Welcome to join our Discord：Dww95Kh6Gj

__________________________________________________________________

🧭 Grand Strategy: Build Your Power, Reforge Civilization

Cataclysm Era offers a dynamic strategic world full of possibilities.

Join an existing faction—or rise as an independent ruler—to conquer the wasteland.

Shape the world through war, diplomacy, trade, and policy.

Experience a simulated economic ecosystem, where population, industry, technology, policy, and prices all interact.
Every decision you make can bring prosperity—or ruin—to a city.

⚔️ Real-Time Tactics: A Fusion of Strategy and Action

  • Formation Editor: Design each squad’s formation freely.

  • Unit Customization: Equip soldiers with diverse weapons, armor, and gear.

  • Real-Time Command: Adapt to terrain, reposition your troops, and overcome crises on the fly.

🎯 Top-Down Shooter: Lead from the Frontlines

In the heat of battle, you are not just a commander—you’re a warrior.
Take control of your character in top-down combat, turning the tide with precise maneuvers amidst gunfire and explosions.

Progression System:

  • Develop unique skills and traits to define your playstyle.

  • Strengthen yourself through exploration, research, technology, or psychic power.

  • Awaken extraordinary abilities—use telekinesis to control weapons and objects, unleashing devastating attacks!

__________________________________________________________________

Content Warning:

This game contains adult themes, including:

  • Blood and violence

  • Indirect sexual references
short_desc: Build your forces, conquer cities, and unite the wasteland. Cataclysm Era merges real-time tactics, fast-paced top-down battles, and deep management systems to let you forge a new order from the world’s remains.
